indicator.name: Food-Insecurity Risk Probability (experimental)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province is at HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): the regional SWS hunger rate (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). Estimated by the E56 LightGBM model (two quarters ahead of the latest predictor quarter). It is a risk classification, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity; hunger is measured only for the whole region.
indicator.horizon: two-quarter-ahead forecast issued 2026-10-01 from predictors through 2026-Q3 (latest observed food-insecurity risk data: 2026-Q2)
indicator.source: SWS hunger (Balance Luzon); PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); news; official rice-policy orders; PSA 2021 SAE poverty (candidate input)
indicator.caveat: Risk classification from regional hunger and provincial food prices, not a measured provincial prevalence. Development evidence only (E56). Indicative decision support only. Target data (SWS hunger and PSA CPI) were known through 2026-Q2 at the issue date; predictors run through 2026-Q3 (CPI through 2026-08). The 2026-Q3 SWS round and September 2026 CPI were released after the issue date and are not used. Direct food-insecurity surveys (FNRI FIES, PSA subsistence) end in 2023.

region.derivation: Mean of 5 published province scores; the model has no region-level series.

laguna_expl.narrative: Food-insecurity risk (high regional hunger together with provincial food-price pressure) in Laguna for 2027-Q1 is forecast LOW (model score 7%: the two parts that follow, multiplied together; not a tested probability): regional hunger is likely to stay above 11.3% (96%) and provincial food-price pressure is unlikely (7%); the target needs both. Within the price part, Market / Prices lowered it and Employment lowered it. No early warning: food-price pressure 7%, HIGH-risk score 7%. Food prices in Laguna were 2.9% higher than a year earlier (latest months to 2026-08); the price condition needs more than 6.05% (this province's usual 2021-2022 level) or food prices rising faster than prices overall. Prices overall rose faster (6.9%), which this target counts as less food-price pressure, although it also means a peso buys less. Regional hunger (SWS, Balance Luzon) was 17.3% in 2026-Q2, above the 11.3% line. Slower food inflation does not mean food has become affordable; it means prices are rising more slowly. The model lowered its estimate while national unemployment rose (+0.90 points); this is a statistical pattern in a short history, not evidence that job losses reduce food stress. Some OFW Remittance figures were not yet published when the forecast was issued; the model's effect for that group partly or wholly reflects how it handles a missing figure, not an observed value. In back-tests, 3 of 11 price-pressure probabilities below 20% were followed by HIGH, so a low value can miss emerging stress; treat it as uncertain. This is an experimental forecast of a food-stress risk indicator (SWS regional hunger and PSA food prices), not a measure of household food insecurity. These are model attributions, not causes.
laguna_expl.note: This experimental forecast is the probability of HIGH food-insecurity risk: the regional SWS hunger rate staying above 11.3% AND food-price pressure in the province (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's usual 2021-2022 level). Hunger is measured for the whole region only, so differences between provinces come from food prices. The bars are exact SHAP values (TreeSHAP) of the LightGBM model's food-price part, in log-odds, grouped into the five factor groups: Market / Prices also includes the projected food inflation built from PSA CPI (the model's starting point) and the rice-policy orders; each group includes its own news share; the total volume of news and, at origins where the model selected it, PSA 2021 poverty are left out of the bars. A group with no observed input at the issue date is shown as insufficient data. Employment and OFW figures are national. These are model attributions, not causes. Early warning (E58): ALERT when HIGH food-insecurity risk is forecast; EMERGING when food-price pressure is likely but the hunger condition is not confirmed by the latest (older) hunger reading. Warnings support DA review and planning; they are not official classifications.
